67:6.text: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

67:8.text: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

67:9.text: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

67:10.text: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

67:12.text: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
